summary:
AstroPulse is an autonomous, AI-assisted biometric telemetry and predictive readiness platform designed for deep-space Artemis and Mars missions where Earth communication delays of up to 24 minutes each way require onboard medical decision support.

Built around NASA Human Research Program (HRP) physiological ranges, AstroPulse combines a Python FastAPI machine learning engine (Random Forest Regressor for EVA Readiness Scoring and Isolation Forest for unsupervised anomaly detection) with an embedded client-side Edge AI fallback so crew monitoring remains 100% operational even offline. An interactive Biometric Digital Twin maps live cardiovascular, respiratory, circadian, radiation, and thermoregulatory alerts, while an automated Pre-Spacewalk Airlock Gate evaluates objective Go/No-Go criteria. Crew members use a low-cognitive-load Crew Tablet with voice check-in, personal-baseline drift forecasting, a guardrailed Gemini assistant, and store-and-forward Mars Ground Link, while Flight Surgeons access a PIN-protected triage console and one-click MedEvac Handover PDF export.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:

AstroPulse is a full-stack crew health monitoring application engineered for deep-space exploration (Artemis-IV and Mars transit). It monitors multi-crew physiological telemetry—Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Core Body Temperature, Solar Radiation Flux, Cumulative Radiation Dose, Sleep Architecture, and Cabin CO2—across a 30-day synthetic mission dataset calibrated to NASA Human Research Program (HRP) reference ranges.

1. Dual-Layer Autonomous AI & ML Pipeline:

- Cloud / Habitat ML Engine (FastAPI + scikit-learn): Uses a Random Forest Regressor to compute real-time EVA Readiness Scores (0–100) and an Isolation Forest model to detect multi-parameter physiological drift and anomalies.

- Delay-Tolerant Edge AI Fallback: Embeds an on-device scoring and deterministic rule engine directly in the React client so full triage, alerts, and countermeasure guidance continue uninterrupted during communication blackouts or Mars light-time delays (4–24 minutes).

2. Interactive Biometric Digital Twin & Live Event Simulator:

- BodySystemMap visualizes active physiological strain across five systems (Cardiovascular, Respiratory & ECLSS, Circadian & Neurocognitive, Radiation Shielding, and Thermoregulation).

- Top-bar mission triggers simulate a Solar Particle Event (Solar Flare), EVA Exhaustion, or Circadian Drift in real time, updating vitals, readiness scores, and automated NASA-inspired countermeasures.

3. Automated Pre-Spacewalk Airlock Go / No-Go Gate:

- Continuously evaluates four objective clearance thresholds (Readiness >= 75%, HRV >= 42 ms, Radiation < 1.2 mSv/h, Sleep >= 6.0 hrs) to issue automated GO or NO-GO airlock holds, with PIN-authorized Flight Surgeon waiver overrides.

4. Dual-Role Clinical Workflow & Guardrailed Self-Care Hub:

- Crew Tablet Mode: Provides glanceable vitals, manual and hands-free Web Speech API voice check-ins, adaptive personal-baseline drift tracking (flagging 2+ SD deviations and estimating hours-to-limit breach), a store-and-forward Mars Ground Link queue, and a guardrailed Gemini AI co-pilot that enforces "CONTACT FLIGHT SURGEON" escalation on out-of-range vitals.

- Flight Surgeon Console (PIN-protected, demo code 1969): Delivers fleet-wide triage matrices, live Recharts telemetry streams, direct crew protocol dispatch, and one-click printable Handover / MedEvac PDF reports.

Tools, Languages & Stack Used:

- Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Lucide Icons, Web Speech API, Google Sans typography (deployed on Vercel).

- Backend & ML: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn (Random Forest & Isolation Forest), Google Gemini API (deployed on Render).

Creativity, Impact & Factors Considered:

- Communication Latency & Offline Resilience: Designed specifically around NASA's "Distance from Earth" hazard—ensuring astronauts can evaluate and act on health changes autonomously without waiting up to 48 minutes for round-trip Earth telemetry.

- Clinical Guardrails & Transparency: Synthetic telemetry is clearly documented as a retrain-ready demonstration pipeline, countermeasure guidance defers to mission flight rules rather than prescribing medication doses, and Light/Dark themes adapt to both bright habitat lighting and low-light sleep-cycle shifts.
